items.title: 🤖 KIMI K3.1-Pro 模型正式发布  Kimi 发布 K3.1 Pro，这是 K3.1 系列首款模型，定位为其目前最强的三万亿参数级开放权重模型，支持
items.title_zh: Kimi 发布 K3.1-Pro：三万亿参数开放权重模型，支持百万 token 上下文
items.title_en: Kimi Releases K3.1-Pro: 3-Trillion-Parameter Open-Weight Model With 1M-Token Context
items.summary: Kimi released K3.1-Pro, a 3-trillion-parameter open-weight model with 1M-token context and claimed strong coding/agent benchmark performance, plus a faster Highspeed variant.

items.title: AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
items.title_zh: AI 漏洞挖掘迫使软件团队偿还四十年技术债
items.title_en: AI Vulnerability Discovery Forces Software Teams to Repay 40 Years of Technical Debt
items.summary: An IEEE Spectrum article and Hacker News discussion examine whether AI-driven vulnerability discovery is forcing software teams to address decades of accumulated technical debt.

items.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
items.title_zh: Anthropic 展示可验证大模型推理的密码学证明方案
items.title_en: Anthropic Demonstrates Cryptographic Proofs for Verifiable LLM Inference
items.summary: Anthropic presents a cryptographic approach for clients to verify that a specific large language model was used for inference, with HN commenters debating its overhead, practical alternatives, and attribution.

items.title: Tencent Hy4
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布 Hy4：7700 亿参数开放权重模型，主打游戏开发与开放科学
items.title_en: Tencent Releases Hy4, a 770B-Parameter Open-Weight Model With Game-Dev and Science Focus
items.summary: Tencent releases Hy4, a leading open-weight foundation model with game-development specializations and open-sourced scientific models HyCell and HyPDE.

items.title: 腾讯向甲骨文租用 10 万枚 AI 芯片  腾讯与甲骨文签订价值约 70 亿美元的租约，租用约 10 万枚在中国买不到的先进 AI 芯片，成为其史上最大海外租赁
items.title_zh: 腾讯斥资约70亿美元向甲骨文租用10万枚先进AI芯片
items.title_en: Tencent Leases 100,000 Advanced AI Chips from Oracle in $7B Deal
items.summary: Tencent signed a ~$7 billion, five-year lease with Oracle for roughly 100,000 advanced AI chips unavailable in China, covering multiple Southeast Asian data centers, to accelerate its AI model and agent development.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0 强化文本渲染与联网推理能力  OpenAI 推出基于 GPT Image 2 的新一代图像生成模型
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.0：引入推理与联网搜索，大幅强化文字渲染
items.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Images 2.0 with reasoning, web search and stronger text rendering
items.summary: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.0 (GPT Image 2), adding reasoning and web search to image generation, multi-image visual consistency, 2K output, and significantly better multilingual text rendering.
